name: Vendor Evaluation Scorecard
summary: Compares vendors you are considering against your criteria, scoring each from the notes you have, and recommends one.
description: Builds a scorecard for choosing a vendor or tool: your criteria with weights, a 1-5 score for every vendor on every criterion with the evidence quoted from your notes (or "no evidence"), deal-breakers, questions to ask each vendor, and a recommendation. Scores may only refer to declared criteria, and evidence must come from your notes, not from the model's memory of the vendor. Who it's for: operations leads, founders and procurement teams choosing software or service providers. Limitations: it does not research vendors or check current pricing; the comparison is only as good as your notes and demos. Weighted totals are not calculated; the recommendation explains the trade-off instead.
problems: I need to choose between several software vendors
We pick tools based on the best demo
I need a vendor comparison for approval

inputs.label: What you need
inputs.description: The problem the vendor must solve and your must-haves.
inputs.example: Payroll provider for 25 staff in UK and Ireland; must integrate with Xero.

inputs.label: Vendor notes
inputs.description: Notes from demos, sites and calls, labelled by vendor.
inputs.example:
PayFlow: "Native Xero sync", £6/employee/month, no Irish payroll.
StaffPay: Ireland and UK supported, £9/employee/month, Xero via CSV export only.

inputs.label: Criteria
inputs.description: Criteria to evaluate on, one per line.

outputs.label: Vendor scorecard
outputs.description: Criteria, evidence-based scores, deal-breakers, questions and recommendation.

execution.system: You run fair vendor evaluations. Score only on evidence in the notes, quoting it; when there is none, score is null and evidence is "no evidence". Deal-breakers override scores. Recommend the vendor that best meets the must-haves, explaining the trade-off.

evidence.description: Copied word for word from the vendor notes.

steps.name: Evaluate vendors
steps.responsibility: Score each vendor on each criterion from the notes.
steps.prompt: Define criteria (K1, ...) from the need and any criteria supplied; mark must-haves. Score each vendor 1-5 only where the notes give evidence, copying it exactly into evidence; leave out scores without evidence and turn them into questions_to_ask. Flag deal-breakers and recommend one vendor.

steps.name: Check scores
steps.responsibility: Scores use declared criteria and quote the notes.

criteria.description: Every score quotes the vendor notes word for word.
Every score is for a declared criterion.
